title: Gurbaksh Singh Sibbia v. State of Punjab

content.caseIdentity: Gurbaksh Singh Sibbia v. State of Punjab, (1980) 2 SCC 565
content.holding: Anticipatory bail under Section 438 CrPC (now s. 482 BNSS) is a key safeguard of Article 21; powers of High Courts and Sessions Courts are wide and should not be burdened with unwarranted conditions.
content.relevance: Foundational Constitution Bench ruling on anticipatory bail principles.
